study type: Validation study (with a complex within-subjects design and embedded between-subjects component)
outcome: Psychometric properties of the PL-BSS-R (measurement properties, validity indices, internal consistency, discriminant characteristics)
Correlation between PL-BSS-R and neonatal physical health
Differences in PL-BSS-R scores across delivery modes
cohort: The study included 294 Polish-speaking women in Poland who completed a postpartum survey.
finding: The Polish Birth Satisfaction Scale-Revised (PL-BSS-R) was found to possess very good psychometric properties, making it equivalent to the original English version and suitable for clinical and research use in Poland.
mod_finding: The PL-BSS-R scores were found to differ significantly across various delivery modes.
cross-section timing: Postpartum (neonatal physical health assessed immediately postpartum, PL-BSS-R administered as a 'followup component')
